Let me check reference images one at a time.

The test image shows broad white/cream longitudinal bands running the full leaf length - not fine discrete lesions. Comparing all references viewed:

- **Maize_Streak_Virus**: fine narrow yellow streaks (too narrow vs. the broad white bands in test)
- **Maize_Chlorotic_Dwarf_Virus**: Corn_Disease_65.jpg showed broad pale longitudinal streaking on a corn leaf in a very similar setting (red soil background, similar plant appearance) - best visual match
- **Stewart's Disease**: wilted plants / pale streaks on young seedlings - not matching
- All other classes showed completely different patterns (spots, lesions, rots, mosaics)

The test image's broad white/cream banding running parallel to veins, combined with the red soil background similar to the MCDV reference images, points most strongly to Maize_Chlorotic_Dwarf_Virus.
